officialName: Application for Registration of Title/Interest in a Patent or Share in It or Registration of Any Document Purporting to Affect Proprietorship of the Patent
purpose: Apply to register the applicant's title or interest in a patent (or a share/interest in it), or to register any document affecting the proprietorship of the patent, transmitting the document (or an attested/certified copy) as proof.

layout.notes: Two-column form: left column carries the numbered instructions (1-5); right column carries the running application with inline blanks and superscript markers. The proof-of-title clause offers an OR branch (transmit the accompanying document + certified copy, or transmit an attested copy + the original for verification).

sections.title: Name, address and nationality of the applicant(s).

autofill.derivation: Choose 'I' for a single applicant, 'We' for multiple, from the applicant count in the transfer/assignment documents.

fields.label: Name, address and nationality of the applicant(s)
fields.helpText: Full name (family/principal name first), complete address incl postal index no./code and state, and nationality.

sections.title: Proof of Title
sections.description: Choose one of two alternatives (marker 2): Branch A - 'in proof thereof we transmit the accompanying ...... with a certified copy thereof.' Branch B - 'Transmit herewith an attested copy of ...... in respect of Patent No(s) ...... dated ...... granted to ...... of which the patentee is ...... as well as the original document for verification ......'

fields.helpText: A description of the nature of the document (assignment, mortgage, licence, etc.), its date, and the names, address and nationality of the parties thereto (instruction 2).

attachments.label: The title/interest document itself (assignment, mortgage, licence, etc.)
attachments.note: Transmitted with a certified copy (Branch A) or as an attested copy plus the original document for verification (Branch B).

notes: Note. - For fee: See First Schedule.
Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable (entitlement type, the proof-of-title OR branch, Grantee/Patentee).
Instruction 2 requires a description of the nature of the document, giving its date and the names, address and nationality of the parties thereto.
This is the registration counterpart to a change of proprietorship; distinct from Form 6 (change of applicant pre-grant) and Form 10 (amend granted-patent grantee name).
